label: hourly canary: IMD burned on Ethereum mainnet

input.question: In the one-hour Ethereum mainnet block window ending at this request's pinned head, what is the sum, in raw IMD base units (18 decimals), of the value field in Transfer logs emitted by token 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 whose to address is 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000?

definitions.event: Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value) emitted by 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 only.
definitions.burn: A Transfer log whose to is 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, from any sender.
definitions.unit: Raw base units (18 decimals), summed without rounding. No burns in the window is 0.
definitions.period: Every block in the pinned window, both ends included.
